digest.en: Middle East & Africa leads the board this hour with Ebola en RDC, une épidémie hors de contrôle ?. 25 fresh dispatches in this edition.
digest.hi: इस घंटे पाकिस्तान के इस्लामाबाद में पीआईएमएस अस्पताल में लगी आग ने गायनेकोलॉजी वार्ड में 15 नवजात शिशुओं की मौत कर दी। इसी दौरान श्रीलंका की पहली पारी 290 पर समाप्त हुई, भारत को 213 रन की बढ़त मिली।

articles.title: Ebola en RDC, une épidémie hors de contrôle ?
articles.summary: Dans cet épisode d’Afrique 360°, Enrica Picco et Rinaldo Depagne reçoivent Frédéric Manantsoa Lai, coordinateur des urgences pour Médecins Sans Frontières, et Onesphore Sematumba, analyste senior pour la République démocratique du Congo et le Burundi à Crisis Group, pour parler de l’épidémie d’Ebola en RDC et de ses conséquences sur la population congolaise, déjà marquée par des années de conflit.

articles.title: Avrupa Birliği ve Türkiye: Savunmada Birlik?
articles.summary: İkinci Dünya Savaşı sonrasında şekillenen uluslararası düzen giderek çözülürken, Ankara ve diğer Avrupa başkentlerindeki yetkililer güvenlik alanında birlikte hareket etmedikleri takdirde ciddi risklerle karşı karşıya kalacaklarının giderek daha fazla farkına varıyor. Tehdit algıları farklılık gösterse de, pragmatik ve esnek iş birliği yolları geliştirmeleri hâlâ mümkün. Avrupa Birliği ve Türkiye: Savunmada Birlik?

articles.title: Sanctions without exit strategies are fracturing the global economy
articles.summary: Wars in the 21st century aren’t fought only with missiles and soldiers anymore. Increasingly, they’re fought through banking systems, shipping lanes, semiconductor controls and currency clearing networks. The battlefield has quietly expanded from territory to economic architecture. And what’s happened so far in 2026 suggests that architecture is now splitting into two. Sanctions have long [] The Sanctions without exit strategies are fracturing the global economy.

articles.title: Disney Adventure adds Langkawi as a day visit on select four-night cruises from Dec 31
articles.summary: Under the new itinerary, these select sailings from Singapore will include a visit to Langkawi on Day 3. Guests can either explore Langkawi independently or book shore excursions, known as Port Adventures, through Disney Cruise Line. Disney Adventure adds Langkawi as a day visit on select four-night cruises from Dec 31.

articles.title: Trump administration pauses visa appointments for applicants worldwide
articles.summary: Immigrant visa applicants with scheduled interviews at US embassies and consulates have received emails that their appointments were being rescheduled and that they would receive future notice of a new date, the Financial Times reported. Trump administration pauses visa appointments for applicants worldwide.

S. intelligence and law enforcement agencies to notify individuals when they discover credible and specific threats of murder, severe bodily harm or kidnapping Prominent Sikh separatist says FBI has warned him of new threat on his life.

articles.title: El Salvador, Panama sound alarm on El Nino-fueled drought
articles.summary: Panama's Interior Minister Dinoska Montalvo said the declaration will allow authorities to "to be prepared for what may come with El Nino," which has fueled a severe drought that is ravaging harvests, sparking fears of famine. El Salvador, Panama sound alarm on El Nino-fueled drought.

articles.title: CIA Director Ratcliffe's Surprise Moscow Trip Raises Questions Over Russia, Ukraine, Iran
articles.summary: CIA Director John Ratcliffe made an unannounced visit to Moscow on August 25, US officials confirmed to RFE/RL, a rare trip that comes as Washington’s efforts to end Russia’s war against Ukraine have stalled and tensions over Moscow’s relationship with Iran have intensified. CIA Director Ratcliffe's Surprise Moscow Trip Raises Questions Over Russia, Ukraine, Iran.

articles.title: NYC Mayor Mamdani opposes RSS chief Bhagwat's Madison Square event
articles.summary: Zohran Mamdani said the vision of India that his family taught him was that of "a pluralistic society, of a secular republic that believed in the belonging of each and every person who was from India" NYC Mayor Mamdani opposes RSS chief Bhagwat's Madison Square event.

articles.title: Aggressive Recruiters Are Rounding Up Russians To Fight In Ukraine. In One Town, They're Pushing
articles.summary: Volunteers in the Penza region town of Bashmakovo have formed patrols to prevent military recruiters from taking local men to fight in Ukraine, an unusual grassroots response to the Russian state’s increasingly aggressive efforts to find troops for the war Aggressive Recruiters Are Rounding Up Russians To Fight In Ukraine. In One Town, They're Pushing.

articles.title: Russian Children Reportedly Beaten, Injured At Patriotic Camp Funded By Kremlin
articles.summary: Children at a Russian Orthodox Christian military-patriotic camp have allegedly been beaten and subjected to other physical punishment, prompting a criminal investigation and scrutiny of an organization that has received millions of rubles in state grants. Russian Children Reportedly Beaten, Injured At Patriotic Camp Funded By Kremlin.

articles.title: China-Indonesia deals raise eyebrows over hidden costs
articles.summary: Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi was in Jakarta from August 20 to 22, where he launched a new Comprehensive Strategic Dialogue, initiated a second round of the 2+2 dialogue between foreign and defense ministers, and held a separate meeting with Indonesia’s top economic official, Luhut Binsar Pandjaitan.

articles.title: Supreme court threatens midterms mail-in voting as it backs Trump plan
articles.summary: US president has been obsessed with restricting the ability to vote by mail, despite using it himself. Plus, why we are still fascinated with Meg from the White StripesDon’t already get First Thing in your inbox? Sign up hereGood morning.

articles.title: Haiti ramps up the fight against gangs in the capital, but violence spreads elsewhere
articles.summary: The killings in Kenscoff began late Sunday, when armed men descended on the farming community in the hills overlooking Haiti’s capital, setting homes ablaze and attacking residents. By Monday, bodies lay in the streets and survivors were searching for missing relatives. Haiti ramps up the fight against gangs in the capital, but violence spreads elsewhere.

articles.title: As wars spread, the global food system unravels
articles.summary: A family with four children abandoned its farm in Somalia after armed groups arrived and demanded payments for the right to continue cultivating the land. They walked roughly 100 kilometers to a displacement camp. One of the children died along the way. As wars spread, the global food system unravels.

articles.title: Land degradation is costing far more than restoring: UN deputy chief
articles.summary: Countries are spending too little to restore degraded land even as the economic cost of doing nothing climbs towards $1 trillion a year, UN Deputy Secretary-General Amina Mohammed warned at a major UN land conference in Mongolia. Land degradation is costing far more than restoring: UN deputy chief.

articles.title: Indonesia chokes on haze as blazes intensify amid super ‘El Niño’
articles.summary: In Indonesia’s Kalimantan, fires have ravaged tens of thousands of acres, with suffocating smoke reaching Malaysia and putting Singapore on alertSuwadi can barely see five metres in front of him when he steps outside his home in Indonesian Borneo. Each breath, he says, feels “like smoking a cigarette”. Continue reading Indonesia chokes on haze as blazes intensify amid super ‘El Niño’.

articles.title: Colombia’s new president Abelardo de la Espriella announces immigration crackdown
articles.summary: Far-right leader echoes ally Donald Trump and says operations to ‘track down illegal immigrants’ should begin this week, amid earthquake aftermathColombia’s far-right president, Abelardo de la Espriella, has announced a crackdown on immigrants, ordering authorities to detain and deport people who are in the country irregularly or have committed crimes. In office for just over two weeks, the million Colombia’s new president Abelardo de la Espriella announces immigration crackdown.

articles.title: Ukraine Appeals For More Air Defense Amid Independence Celebrations
articles.summary: As Ukraine marked the 35th anniversary of its declaration of independence from the Soviet Union, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy hosted a summit of world leaders from the so-called Coalition of the Willing -- a group of countries that has pledged military and security support for Ukraine. Ukraine Appeals For More Air Defense Amid Independence Celebrations.

articles.title: Election Observers Say Kazakh President's Party Had 'Undue Advantage' As It Grabs 70 Percent Of Vote
articles.summary: A party formed just four months ago has swept Kazakhstan’s parliamentary election, tightening President Qasym-Zhomart Toqaev’s grip on power amid international criticism over a lack of political competition, media pressure, and questions about the vote count. Election Observers Say Kazakh President's Party Had 'Undue Advantage' As It Grabs 70 Percent Of Vote.

articles.title: Video shows hundreds held captive after Nigeria mosque kidnapping
articles.summary: Gunmen ‌attacked worshippers in Dekara village on Friday taking women, children and older peopleAn armed group has posted a video showing what ⁠residents said were about ⁠600 women, children and ​older people abducted in an attack on a mosque in Nigeria’s north-central Niger State last week.

articles.title: Can restoring land create jobs? These young entrepreneurs are proving it
articles.summary: From Ecuador to Bangladesh, a new generation of entrepreneurs is turning land restoration into economic opportunity. Whether repurposing agricultural waste, building greenhouses or deploying AI-powered sensors, they are showing, with support from a United Nations-backed initiative, that restoring land can also generate income and improve livelihoods. Can restoring land create jobs? These young entrepreneurs are proving it.

articles.title: Children still at risk despite drop in acute hunger
articles.summary: Among tent cities pitched on the rubble of destroyed homes in Gaza, children are, by one measure, finally getting enough to eat. By another, however, many of them may never fully recover, according to a new study by the UN Children’s Fund (UNICEF) released on Monday. Children still at risk despite drop in acute hunger.

articles.title: Civilian suffering grows in Russia-Ukraine war
articles.summary: As spiralling drone and missile attacks on civilians in the ongoing Russia-Ukraine war continue, top UN officials told the Security Council on Monday that every diplomatic effort must work towards a full, immediate and unconditional ceasefire. UN News app users can follow our live coverage here. Civilian suffering grows in Russia-Ukraine war.

articles.title: Security Council LIVE: War, hunger, flooding escalates in Sudan
articles.summary: Suffering in Sudan continues to grow in the world’s worst humanitarian crisis amid brutal mass killings, abductions and rape, top UN officials warned the Security Council on Monday, calling for action to end the four-year-long war. UN News app users can follow our coverage here. Security Council LIVE: War, hunger, flooding escalates in Sudan.

articles.summary: China South China Sea Installations: चीन वो देश है, जो अपने आसपास के इलाकों पर हमेशा नजर रखता है. इतना ही नहीं वो इस पर लगातार दबाव भी बनाकर रखता है. यही वजह है कि दक्षिण चीन सागर में अपना दबदबा बनाने के लिए उसने आर्टिफिशियल आइलैंड भी बना रखे हैं. एक बार फिर उसकी गतिविधियां चर्चा में हैं क्योंकि वो यहां पर एक बड़ा सैन्य अड्डा विकसित कर रहा है और इसने ट्रंप की नींद उड़ा दी है.
